scope: Isolated jsdom execution of owned inline behaviors and evidence merge with synthetic storage only. No network requests, patient records, physical camera, clinical validation or production publication.

checks.name: Mental-health urgent support is available before any answer and does not assume a country or universal phone number
Mood choices are descriptive and ephemeral; a low or calm selection cannot hide urgent help or assign a reassuring screening score
STRAW summary starts without assumed values or classifications and refuses an empty submission
A plausible regular cycle series produces only typed observations; no stage, fertility, ovarian age or diagnosis is calculated or persisted
A very long gap or a context choice cannot yield menopause classification
Invalid zero, fractional and over-limit values fail visibly; the numeric limit is explicitly software validation
Input/context edits invalidate stale summaries and additional rows have a 20-row entry cap
The foot-care page contains explicit limits, not a prescribed herb/heat regimen or fabricated efficacy statistics
New clinical regions declare English and opt out of partial interface dictionary translation
Fresh safety evidence keys resolve to dated supporting sources and disclaim app validation; the STRAW record replaces legacy metadata
